assumption_notes: enrichment cost scales with distinct texts sent, using the pilot's measured cost per text (system prompt amortized over 50-review requests)
base = measured cost per distinct text (retries included); conservative = 30% more tokens per review, 10% extra retry traffic, group+memo inputs 3x larger at full scale
verification is a fixed declared sample (400 reviews), not a fraction of every review
group naming and memo run once per run; their cost is fixed overhead, never multiplied per review
stronger-model fallback is disabled (fraction 0); if enabled, cost = texts x fraction x enrich cost per text x (Sonnet/Haiku output price ratio)
time = texts / (measured single-worker texts per second x workers x 0.8 efficiency); provider rate limits may make it slower
the 77,978 distinct texts for the 100k sample come from the prepare stage with the fixed sample seed
